I am the Director of Research and Chief Economist at the [International Growth Centre](https://www.theigc.org/) and a Research Fellow in the Department of Economics at the [London School of Economics](https://www.lse.ac.uk/), within the Economics of Energy & Environment programme. I hold a PhD in Economics from LSE.

My research spans energy, AI, climate change, and growth in the developing world. I have advised governments across Asia and Africa on energy and public finance issues, including Pakistan, Ethiopia, and Myanmar, and I lead a team of over 20 economists working across IGC's global portfolio.

### Research Themes

**Energy and power sector reform** — Power purchase agreements, smart meters, electricity theft, and solar diffusion, with evidence from Pakistan, Ethiopia, Ghana, and Myanmar.

**AI, structural transformation, and growth** — How artificial intelligence reshapes the ladder of development for low- and middle-income economies.

**Climate change and human capital** — Mobility, migration, and the unequal effects of a changing climate.

**Public finance** — Customs evasion, tariff design, and subsidy reform, with a focus on Pakistan.
